summary.intent: Build a long-horizon autoresearch system to improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs), capturing agentic journeys through QuadratureNexus and FLUME VAE into SurrealDB, then analyzing those journeys via Ouroboros and Mycelium to close a feedback loop that improves QuadratureNexus alignment scores.
summary.outcome: Delivered a fully validated closed-loop pipeline: E1–E6 wired real FLUME encoding and EVO lifecycle tracking into QuadratureNexus; E57 fixed a critical SET-vs-additive bug in apply_mycelium_feedback enabling genuine consensus compounding; E55–E62 validated the full research arc with convergence formula consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125 × (1−lr/2)^n; SurrealDB persistence was fixed (4 bugs); an overnight loop with retirement criterion runs continuously; 30+ pre-existing test failures were fixed across ARC solver, compound executor, MCP client, and async patterns.

repo: apply_mycelium_feedback used SET semantics (_score_adjustments[vt] = adjustment) causing cycle-2 decay; fix is _mycelium_calibration[vt] += adjustment with _score_adjustments reading from calibration

run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally overwrites _score_adjustments on every call (line 307 of overnight_evo_loop.py), so experiments must use nexus.deliberate() directly to preserve Mycelium adjustments

SurrealDB probe must use 'RETURN true;' not 'SELECT 1;' (SurrealQL syntax); datetime fields require time::now() not ISO string literals; SCHEMAFULL tables block arbitrary metadata subfields — pack variable data into option<string> result field
QuadratureNexus has a two-layer calibration model: _mycelium_calibration (cross-cycle, stable) vs _score_adjustments (per-deliberation, overwritten by run_llm_deliberation)

ManifoldEnv 19D obs (12D state + 3D Bloch + 4D fiber), 12D action space; verifiable reward = 0.4*r_hiho + 0.2*r_conservation + 0.2*r_unitarity + 0.2*r_gauge; r_hiho = 1 - 4*var(position) peaks at 1.0 when all dims=0.5
UCB1 with trials=0 gives infinity, so untested transforms fill the beam_search beam before proven-correct transforms; fix: select best by actual score before UCB1 sorting for exploration
The DRR (Design Review Report) gate was blocking skill refinement in executor.py; should be advisory-only — only retrospection should gate refinement
psutil.virtual_memory() returns >90% used in production environment, blocking executor tests that check memory guardrails; tests need autouse fixture mocking it
autoresearch.jsonl tracked by git causes pre-commit stash conflicts when the overnight loop writes to it during commit; solution: git rm --cached + .gitignore
asyncio.wait_for() with negative timeout causes infinite tight spin-loop (not an error, just fires immediately every loop iteration); guard with 'if remaining_s < 30: break'

code.finding: _mycelium_calibration must be initialized in __init__ as dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0); apply_mycelium_feedback must use += into _mycelium_calibration then copy to _score_adjustments; returns mechanism='additive_calibration'
beam_search UCB1 bug: track best_chain by actual score before UCB1 sorting; UCB1 should only govern which chains to expand, not which is the best answer
DRR gate incorrectly set should_refine=False on failure; DRR is advisory only per design — only retrospection gates skill refinement
_find_project_root needs fallback to pyproject.toml/CLAUDE.md parent when no .context directory exists; otherwise tests in /tmp fail with ContextLoadError
vault_write is async but was called synchronously in 6 places; fix via _fire_vault_write helper that uses loop.create_task() if event loop running, else asyncio.run()
red_team_veto only checked for 'contradiction' keyword in strategy string; should also fire when all reviewer critiques contain 'CONTRADICTION: TRUE'
connect() must use 'RETURN true;' probe not 'SELECT 1;'; all CREATE statements need time::now() for datetime; EVO biography must go in result field (option<string>) not metadata subfields

2x2 symmetric grid [[0,1],[1,0]] is geometrically ambiguous (both flip_h and invert solve it); test for invert requires 3x3 unambiguous grid where only color inversion works
Added _logged_opportunity_hashes set for deduplication; generate_next_experiments() uses HIHO_THRESHOLD=0.5 — exploit (parameter tuning) when coherence>=0.5, explore (new hypothesis) when below

workflow: Retirement criterion for autoresearch experiments: CV(last-10 keep metrics) < 0.05 AND n_keeps >= 20 → converged; n_discards >= min_runs AND keep_frac == 0 → noise; both auto-prune from schedule
E57 research arc pattern: identify bug (E56 SET decay) → validate fix analytically → implement → write 11 regression tests → confirm with autoresearch loop (100% keep)
Convergence formula for Mycelium compounding: consensus_n = threshold - gap_0 * (1-lr/2)^n; at lr=1.0 asymptotically approaches 0.85; at lr=2.0 crosses threshold in one cycle
Gemini worktrees are cleaned up automatically when no changes are detected; never rely on worktree files for persistent work — commit to main repo branch
Pre-commit ruff-format hook reformats files after Edit, silently reverting intended changes; workaround is to apply changes via python3 scripts or run ruff format before staging
timeit.default_timer() is time.perf_counter() on Python 3.3+ — monotonic, sub-microsecond, immune to NTP corrections; correct choice for experiment wall-clock timing

Multi-agent parallel team pattern: 3+ specialist agents on independent subtasks (tests, experiments, harness) while main context handles cross-cutting concerns (AutoresearchEngine, adversarial review)
SurrealDB HTTP endpoint: POST to /sql with headers surreal-ns, surreal-db, Accept: application/json, Authorization: Basic base64(root:root)
asyncio.wait_for with negative timeout doesn't raise immediately at process level — it creates a fast spin loop; always guard with 'if remaining_s < 30: break' before the timeout computation
IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 due to floating point; use result.approved (direct comparison) as authoritative threshold-crossing signal, not float mean
